verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Ollama is a local model runner, but no evidence item mentions GGUF loading or support. The closest material is indirect: llama.cpp underpinnings, a q4_K_M quant name in a user benchmark, and pulling models from HF. None of it documents loading GGUF-packaged models, and inferring support from that would rely on outside knowledge.
